title: Typewriter and Clock
author: Mara Dunmore
blurb: Edmund Amberdale, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
